Given
- Heads: HA = 120 m, HB = 100 m, HC = 70 m
- Pipes: (L, D)1 = (1500 m, 0.30 m), (L, D)2 = (800 m, 0.20 m), (L, D)3 = (1200 m, 0.25 m)
- ε = 0.00026 m, ν = 1.0e-6 m2/s, g = 9.81 m/s2
- A1 = πD1^2/4 = 0.0706858 m2; A2 = 0.0314159 m2; A3 = 0.0490874 m2
- L/D: (L/D)1 = 5000, (L/D)2 = 4000, (L/D)3 = 4800

Assume 70 < HJ < 120. We expect A→J, B↔J depends on HJ vs 100, and J→C since HJ > 70.

For a chosen HJ, each pipe satisfies Darcy–Weisbach:
ΔH = f (L/D) V2/(2g), with V = |Q|/A and f from Colebrook:
1/√f = -2 log10[ ε/(3.7D) + 2.51/(Re√f) ], Re = VD/ν

Iterate to find HJ so that inflows = outflows at J.

Iteration at HJ ≈ 101.07 m (final balance shown below):
- Pipe 1 (A→J): ΔH1 = 120 − HJ = 18.94 m
  • Assume f1 ≈ 0.02, compute V, then Re1 ≈ 1.95×0.30/1e-6 ≈ 5.85×10^5
  • Colebrook with ε/D1 = 0.00026/0.30 = 8.667×10^-4:
    1/√f1 = -2 log10(2.342×10^-4 + 2.51/(5.85e5√f1)) → f1 ≈ 0.01955
  • V1 = √[2gΔH1/(f1 L/D)] = √[19.62×18.94/(0.01955×5000)] ≈ 1.949 m/s
  • Q1 = A1 V1 ≈ 0.0706858×1.949 ≈ 0.1378 m3/s (A→J)

- Pipe 2: with HJ > 100, flow is J→B, ΔH2 = HJ − 100 = 1.06 m
  • ε/D2 = 0.00026/0.20 = 0.00130; initial V ≈ 0.47 m/s → Re2 ≈ 9.5×10^4
  • Colebrook: 1/√f2 = -2 log10(3.5135×10^-4 + 2.51/(9.5e4√f2)) → f2 ≈ 0.0233
  • V2 = √[19.62×1.06/(0.0233×4000)] ≈ 0.475 m/s
  • Q2 = A2 V2 ≈ 0.0314159×0.475 ≈ 0.0149 m3/s (J→B; i.e., into reservoir B)

- Pipe 3 (J→C): ΔH3 = HJ − 70 = 31.06 m
  • ε/D3 = 0.00026/0.25 = 0.00104; V ≈ 2.50 m/s → Re3 ≈ 6.25×10^5
  • Colebrook: 1/√f3 = -2 log10(2.811×10^-4 + 2.51/(6.25e5√f3)) → f3 ≈ 0.02029
  • V3 = √[19.62×31.06/(0.02029×4800)] ≈ 2.502 m/s
  • Q3 = A3 V3 ≈ 0.0490874×2.502 ≈ 0.1228 m3/s (J→C)

Mass balance at HJ ≈ 101.07 m:
- Inflow: Q1 ≈ 0.1378 m3/s
- Outflows: Q2 + Q3 ≈ 0.0149 + 0.1228 = 0.1377 m3/s
Balance is satisfied within ~0.00002 m3/s; thus HJ ≈ 101.07 m is consistent.

Answers:
- (a) HJ ≈ 101.07 m
- (b) Q1 ≈ 137.8 L/s from A to J
- (c) |Q2| ≈ 14.9 L/s; direction: water flows into reservoir B (from J to B)
- (d) Q3 ≈ 122.8 L/s from J to C

FINAL (a): 101.07 m
FINAL (b): 137.8 L/s
FINAL (c): 14.9 L/s
FINAL (d): 122.8 L/s
